  | 'd' => 1  -- double

  | 'D' => 4  -- cdouble (complex double)
  | 'G' => 5  -- clongdouble (complex long double)
  | _   => 6  -- other types (lowest precedence)

    ⦃⌜typeset.toList = ['G', 'D', 'F', 'g', 'd', 'f']⌝⦄
